confdir.description: Directory where additional chrony configuration files are stored.

sourcedir.description: Directory where DHCP lease information is stored for source tracking.

sourcedir_sources_d.description: Directory where source configuration files can be dropped.

keyfile.description: Path to the file containing keys for NTS authentication.

driftfile.description: Path to the file used to store the clock drift rate.

ntsdumpdir.description: Directory where NTS key state is dumped.

logdir.description: Directory where chrony log files are stored.

maxupdateskew.description: Maximum acceptable clock update skew in milliseconds.

makestep.description: Make step correction if the offset is larger than 1 second, only if the system has been running for more than 3 seconds.

leapsectz.description: Timezone specification for leap second data.

servers.description: List of NTP servers to synchronize with.

daemon_opts.description: Additional options passed to the chrony daemon.
